messages.text:
The API test passes after the SQL alias fix; the DB test failure is test contamination from the API mutation adding an item to the shared local cart, not a calculation failure.

I also found the installed TanStack Start version expects the default entry pattern or a router entry exporting `getRouter`, so I’m aligning the entries and isolating test database state.
